package highlight import ( "fmt" "regexp" "strconv" "strings" ) // Mode is a highlight.js mode definition. Language files build these; the // compiler turns them into compiledMode. type Mode struct { ClassName string Begin string End string BeginKeywords string EndSameAsBegin bool EndsParent bool EndsWithParent bool ExcludeBegin bool ExcludeEnd bool ReturnBegin bool ReturnEnd bool Skip bool Illegal string Match string Keywords Keywords Lexemes string Contains []*Mode Variants []*Mode Starts *Mode SubLanguage []string Relevance int HasRelevance bool OnBegin func(m *match, resp *Response) OnEnd func(m *match, resp *Response) beforeBegin func(m *match, resp *Response) cachedVariants []*Mode frozen bool } // Keywords maps a className to a space-separated word list whose entries may // carry a `|relevance` suffix. The special key "$pattern" is the keyword // scanner pattern. type Keywords map[string]string // Language is a mode plus registration metadata. type Language struct { Name string Aliases []string CaseInsensitive bool DisableAutodetect bool ClassNameAliases map[string]string Mode } // Self is the `contains: ['self']` sentinel. var Self = &Mode{} // Variant returns a copy of base with override applied, for mode.variants. func Variant(base *Mode, override func(*Mode)) *Mode { c := cloneMode(base) override(c) return c } // Zero returns a mode with an explicit relevance of 0. func Zero(m Mode) *Mode { m.Relevance = 0 m.HasRelevance = true return &m } type keywordData struct { className string relevance int } type compiledMode struct { className string relevance int skip bool excludeBegin bool excludeEnd bool returnBegin bool returnEnd bool endSameAsBegin bool endsParent bool endsWithParent bool keywords map[string]keywordData keywordPatternRe *regexp.Regexp beginRe *regexp.Regexp endRe *regexp.Regexp illegalRe *regexp.Regexp terminatorEnd string contains []*compiledMode starts *compiledMode matcher *resumableMultiRegex subLanguage []string beforeBegin func(m *match, resp *Response) onBegin func(m *match, resp *Response) onEnd func(m *match, resp *Response) } // Response is highlight.js's Response: callbacks can ignore the match. type Response struct { data map[string]string isMatchIgnored bool } // IgnoreMatch tells the engine not to apply the current rule. func (r *Response) IgnoreMatch() { r.isMatchIgnored = true } type compiler struct { language *Language compiled map[*Mode]*compiledMode } func compileLanguage(language *Language) (*compiledMode, error) { c := &compiler{language: language} for _, m := range language.Contains { if m == Self { return nil, fmt.Errorf("highlight: contains `self` is not supported at the top level of %q", language.Name) } } // Compile a deep clone: the reference mutates mode objects during compile, // and shared helper modes (C_LINE_COMMENT_MODE, ...) are reused across // languages. Cloning keeps each language's compilation independent and lets // concurrent highlights share the result. root := cloneTree(&language.Mode, map[*Mode]*Mode{}) return c.compileMode(root, nil) } func (c *compiler) langRe(src string) (*regexp.Regexp, error) { flags := "m" if c.language.CaseInsensitive { flags += "i" } return compilePattern(src, flags) } func (c *compiler) compileMode(mode *Mode, parent *compiledMode) (*compiledMode, error) { // The reference sets isCompiled before compiling `contains`, so a language // may reference itself (JSON's value container holds its own object and // array modes). Memoising the in-progress compile keeps that graph finite. if existing, ok := c.compiled[mode]; ok { return existing, nil } cmode := &compiledMode{ className: mode.ClassName, skip: mode.Skip, excludeBegin: mode.ExcludeBegin, excludeEnd: mode.ExcludeEnd, returnBegin: mode.ReturnBegin, returnEnd: mode.ReturnEnd, endSameAsBegin: mode.EndSameAsBegin, endsParent: mode.EndsParent, endsWithParent: mode.EndsWithParent, beforeBegin: mode.beforeBegin, onBegin: mode.OnBegin, onEnd: mode.OnEnd, subLanguage: mode.SubLanguage, } c.compiled[mode] = cmode if mode.Match != "" { if mode.Begin != "" || mode.End != "" { return nil, fmt.Errorf("highlight: begin & end are not supported with match") } mode.Begin = mode.Match } // beginKeywords syntactic sugar. if parent != nil && mode.BeginKeywords != "" { words := strings.Split(mode.BeginKeywords, " ") mode.Begin = `\b(` + strings.Join(words, "|") + `)` preceding := mode.beforeBegin mode.beforeBegin = func(m *match, resp *Response) { if preceding != nil { preceding(m, resp) if resp.isMatchIgnored { return } } if m.index > 0 && m.input[m.index-1] == '.' { resp.IgnoreMatch() return } // The reference's `(?!\.)(?=\b|\s)` suffix: after the match the next // character must be absent or a non-word character other than `.`. next := m.index + len(m.lexeme) if next < len(m.input) { b := m.input[next] if b == '.' || isWordByte(b) { resp.IgnoreMatch() } } } cmode.beforeBegin = mode.beforeBegin if mode.Keywords == nil { mode.Keywords = Keywords{"keyword": mode.BeginKeywords} } if !mode.HasRelevance { mode.Relevance = 0 mode.HasRelevance = true } mode.BeginKeywords = "" } if mode.HasRelevance { cmode.relevance = mode.Relevance } else { cmode.relevance = 1 } keywordPattern := "" if mode.Keywords != nil { keywordPattern = mode.Keywords["$pattern"] delete(mode.Keywords, "$pattern") cmode.keywords = compileKeywords(mode.Keywords, c.language.CaseInsensitive) } if mode.Lexemes != "" && keywordPattern != "" { return nil, fmt.Errorf("highlight: prefer keywords.$pattern to mode.lexemes") } if keywordPattern == "" { keywordPattern = mode.Lexemes } if keywordPattern == "" { keywordPattern = `\w+` } re, err := c.langRe(keywordPattern) if err != nil { return nil, err } cmode.keywordPatternRe = re if parent != nil { if mode.Begin == "" { mode.Begin = `\B|\b` } beginRe, err := c.langRe(mode.Begin) if err != nil { return nil, err } cmode.beginRe = beginRe if mode.EndSameAsBegin { mode.End = mode.Begin } if mode.End == "" && !mode.EndsWithParent { mode.End = `\B|\b` } if mode.End != "" { endRe, err := c.langRe(mode.End) if err != nil { return nil, err } cmode.endRe = endRe } cmode.terminatorEnd = mode.End if mode.EndsWithParent && parent.terminatorEnd != "" { if mode.End != "" { cmode.terminatorEnd += "|" } cmode.terminatorEnd += parent.terminatorEnd } } if mode.Illegal != "" { illegalRe, err := c.langRe(mode.Illegal) if err != nil { return nil, err } cmode.illegalRe = illegalRe } contains := mode.Contains if contains == nil { contains = nil } expanded := make([]*Mode, 0, len(contains)) for _, child := range contains { if child == Self { child = mode } expanded = append(expanded, expandOrCloneMode(child)...) } for _, child := range expanded { compiledChild, err := c.compileMode(child, cmode) if err != nil { return nil, err } cmode.contains = append(cmode.contains, compiledChild) } if mode.Starts != nil { compiledStarts, err := c.compileMode(mode.Starts, parent) if err != nil { return nil, err } cmode.starts = compiledStarts } cmode.matcher = c.buildModeRegex(cmode) return cmode, nil } func (c *compiler) buildModeRegex(mode *compiledMode) *resumableMultiRegex { mm := &resumableMultiRegex{caseIgnore: c.language.CaseInsensitive} for _, term := range mode.contains { mm.addRule(term.beginRe, matchData{rule: term, typ: ruleBegin}) } if mode.terminatorEnd != "" { re, err := c.langRe(mode.terminatorEnd) if err == nil { mm.addRule(re, matchData{typ: ruleEnd}) } } if mode.illegalRe != nil { mm.addRule(mode.illegalRe, matchData{typ: ruleIllegal}) } return mm } func compileKeywords(raw Keywords, caseInsensitive bool) map[string]keywordData { out := map[string]keywordData{} var compileList func(className, words string) compileList = func(className, words string) { for _, keyword := range strings.Split(words, " ") { if keyword == "" { continue } key := keyword if caseInsensitive { key = strings.ToLower(key) } pair := strings.SplitN(keyword, "|", 2) word := pair[0] if caseInsensitive { word = strings.ToLower(word) } out[word] = keywordData{className: className, relevance: scoreForKeyword(strings.SplitN(keyword, "|", 2)...)} } } for className, words := range raw { compileList(className, words) } return out } func scoreForKeyword(parts ...string) int { keyword := parts[0] if len(parts) > 1 && parts[1] != "" { n, err := strconv.Atoi(parts[1]) if err == nil { return n } } if commonKeyword(keyword) { return 0 } return 1 } var commonKeywords = map[string]bool{ "of": true, "and": true, "for": true, "in": true, "not": true, "or": true, "if": true, "then": true, "parent": true, "list": true, "value": true, } func commonKeyword(keyword string) bool { return commonKeywords[strings.ToLower(keyword)] } func dependencyOnParent(mode *Mode) bool { if mode == nil { return false } return mode.EndsWithParent || dependencyOnParent(mode.Starts) } func expandOrCloneMode(mode *Mode) []*Mode { if len(mode.Variants) > 0 { if mode.cachedVariants == nil { mode.cachedVariants = mode.Variants } return mode.cachedVariants } if dependencyOnParent(mode) { clone := cloneMode(mode) if mode.Starts != nil { clone.Starts = cloneMode(mode.Starts) } return []*Mode{clone} } return []*Mode{mode} } // cloneTree deep-clones a mode tree for one language's compilation. func cloneTree(m *Mode, seen map[*Mode]*Mode) *Mode { if m == nil || m == Self { return m } if clone, ok := seen[m]; ok { return clone } clone := cloneMode(m) seen[m] = clone clone.Contains = nil for _, child := range m.Contains { clone.Contains = append(clone.Contains, cloneTree(child, seen)) } if len(m.Variants) > 0 { clone.Variants = clone.Variants[:0] for _, v := range m.Variants { clone.Variants = append(clone.Variants, cloneTree(v, seen)) } } if m.Starts != nil { clone.Starts = cloneTree(m.Starts, seen) } return clone } func cloneMode(m *Mode) *Mode { c := *m if m.Contains != nil { c.Contains = append([]*Mode(nil), m.Contains...) } c.Variants = nil return &c } func isWordByte(b byte) bool { return b == '_' || (b >= '0' && b <= '9') || (b >= 'a' && b <= 'z') || (b >= 'A' && b <= 'Z') }
